_comment: GENERATED snapshot — see lib/gdpr/export-tables.ts header for the catalogue query and classification rules. Held as JSON (not .ts) so the sensitive table-NAME literals live outside the source-tree census scans; those scans walk only .ts/.tsx.

excluded.staff_secrets: government identifiers (NI numbers) — separate controlled subject-export path, never bulk-dumped
excluded.accounting_pushed_entities: service telemetry: provider-sync push-once high-water-mark (org/provider/entity_type/entity_id/pushed_at) — internal integration bookkeeping, no tenant business data; the referenced invoices/payments are themselves exported via their own tables

excluded.ai_employee_budget_limits: service telemetry: AI budget governance internals (per-employee spend caps) — HQ-side control config, not tenant business data
excluded.ai_org_budget_ceilings: service telemetry: AI budget governance internals (per-org ceiling override) — HQ-side control config, not tenant business data
excluded.billing_events: platform billing (CrewFlow-side, not tenant business data)
excluded.billing_invoices: platform billing (CrewFlow-side, not tenant business data)
excluded.org_subscriptions: platform billing (CrewFlow-side SaaS subscription state, not tenant business data); Stripe ids are handles, not secrets

excluded.import_rows: import staging rows (real records exported via their own tables)
excluded.calendar_watch_channels: credentials/integration state: provider watch verification_token + channel registration
excluded.calendar_pulled_events: integration mirror of external provider calendar events (provider is source of truth; may include third-party attendee data)

_order_keys_comment: Stable, unique per-row ORDER BY column for the fully-paged DSAR export (server/services/gdpr-export.ts). Every exported table is paged via fetchAllRows, which REQUIRES a stable total ordering so no row is dropped/repeated at a page boundary. The default key is 'id'; the entries below are the ONLY exported tables lacking an 'id' column — each maps to a column that is unique WITHIN an org-pinned read (the non-org_id part of the table's primary key; org_id is constant under the .eq('org_id', orgId) pin). Ordering by a column that does not exist on a table is a hard read error (Postgres 42703) that would abort the whole export, so this map must stay exhaustive — the integration FORWARD drift test orders each table by its key against live Postgres, failing CI if a key is wrong or a new id-less table appears.
_erasure_comment: GDPR ERASURE / account-teardown (Art. 17) classification — the DESTRUCTIVE mirror of the export census, consumed by lib/gdpr/erase-tables.ts and server/services/gdpr-erase.ts. Every table in `known` is classified into exactly one disposition: `erasure_anonymise` (statutory-retention records — UK Companies Act s386 / HMRC 6-year financial + tax + payroll duties, plus accountability trails carrying PII: the ROW is KEPT and only PII-named columns are scrubbed, so the statutory numbers/dates/references survive), `erasure_retain` (CrewFlow platform-side records and erasure/export EVIDENCE logs — NOT the tenant's data to erase; left byte-for-byte untouched), or — the DEFAULT for everything not named here — HARD DELETE. Default-destroy is the GDPR-safe default for erasure (the mirror image of export's default-don't-export): a newly-added org-scoped table is DESTROYED unless a reviewer explicitly preserves it, so personal data is never silently retained. The bidirectional drift guard (LIVE ⊆ known, and known == anonymise ∪ retain ∪ hard_delete with no overlap) forces every new live table to be consciously classified. Reasons are recorded so a reviewer / DPO can audit each preservation call. These lists live in JSON (not .ts) for the same reason as the export registry — the source-tree 'who names table X' census walks only .ts/.tsx.

erasure_anonymise.activity_log: accountability trail (Art. 5(2)) carrying actor/description PII — scrub free-text/identity, keep event type + timestamp
erasure_anonymise.ai_invocations: AI cost/governance ledger that may embed tenant prompt/response PII — scrub payload text, keep tokens/cost/timestamps
erasure_anonymise.ai_reply_audits: AI reply audit that may embed message content PII — scrub content, keep the audit skeleton
erasure_anonymise.bank_statements: financial record (Companies Act s386 / HMRC 6y) — keep balances/dates, scrub counterparty PII
erasure_anonymise.bank_statement_lines: financial record (Companies Act s386 / HMRC 6y) — keep amounts/dates, scrub description/counterparty PII
erasure_anonymise.finances: financial record (Companies Act s386 / HMRC 6y) — keep amount/vat/dates, scrub notes/PII
erasure_anonymise.invoices: statutory financial record (VAT/HMRC 6y) — keep totals/vat/invoice number/dates, scrub customer name/address/notes
erasure_anonymise.invoice_line_items: part of the statutory invoice record — keep amounts/qty, scrub free-text description PII
erasure_anonymise.invoice_payments: statutory payment record — keep amount/date/method, scrub payer PII
erasure_anonymise.invoice_payment_intents: statutory payment record — keep amount/status, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.payments: statutory payment record (HMRC 6y) — keep amount/date, scrub payer PII
erasure_anonymise.supplier_payments: statutory financial record (HMRC 6y / CIS) — keep amount/date, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.supplier_payment_allocations: part of the statutory supplier-payment record — keep amounts, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.suppliers: counterparty on retained financial records — keep company name for the ledger, scrub contact PII; row kept so financial FKs resolve
erasure_anonymise.purchase_orders: statutory financial record (HMRC 6y) — keep totals/number/dates, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.purchase_order_line_items: part of the statutory PO record — keep amounts, scrub description PII
erasure_anonymise.goods_received_notes: financial/inventory record supporting the ledger — keep numbers/dates, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.goods_received_lines: part of the GRN record — keep quantities, scrub description PII
erasure_anonymise.retention_releases: financial retention (money held back) record — keep amounts/dates, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.job_billing_plans: financial billing record — keep amounts/stages, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.job_billing_stages: financial billing record — keep amounts/dates, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.payroll_runs: statutory payroll record (HMRC/PAYE — keep 6y) — keep totals/period, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.payroll_lines: statutory payroll record (HMRC/PAYE) — keep gross/tax/NI amounts, scrub employee-identifying PII
erasure_anonymise.payroll_line_adjustments: payroll audit trail (accountability, Art. 5(2)) supporting the statutory payroll record — keep before/after amounts + timestamps, scrub actor identity
erasure_anonymise.payroll_tax_profiles: statutory payroll config (PAYE) — keep tax codes/rates, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.pension_enrolments: statutory auto-enrolment record (Pensions Act) — keep enrolment status/dates, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.holiday_entitlements: statutory employment record (WTR) — keep entitlement figures, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.hmrc_submissions: statutory tax filing record (HMRC) — keep period/status/references, scrub PII in payload
erasure_anonymise.cis_subcontractors: statutory CIS record (HMRC) — keep CIS status, scrub name/UTR/verification PII (already masked elsewhere)
erasure_anonymise.cis_contractor_profiles: statutory CIS record (HMRC) — the org's own contractor profile; keep filing config, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.cis_statements: statutory CIS deduction statement (HMRC) — keep amounts/period, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.cis_statement_payments: part of the statutory CIS statement — keep amounts, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.cis_payment_snapshots: statutory CIS payment snapshot (HMRC) — keep amounts/period, scrub UTR/verification PII
erasure_anonymise.cis_monthly_returns: statutory CIS300 monthly return (HMRC) — keep period/status, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.cis_monthly_return_lines: part of the statutory CIS300 return — keep amounts, scrub PII
erasure_anonymise.cis_bill_details: CIS labour/materials split on a bill (feeds the statutory deduction) — keep amounts, scrub PII

erasure_retain.accounting_pushed_entities: integration bookkeeping (provider-sync push-once markers) — service-internal, no tenant PII; left intact

erasure_retain.billing_invoices: CrewFlow platform billing (the PROCESSOR's own invoices) — CrewFlow must retain; not the tenant's to erase
